title: parallel-lanes run manifest
description: Documentation of the manifest passed as args to run.workflow.js. validateManifest in run.workflow.js is authoritative and also enforces: task ids unique across prelude, lanes and join; no file claimed by two lanes; sonnet and light tasks cannot set security; batch only on light tasks; profile lite needs exactly one lane, at most 8 tasks across prelude, lanes and join, no security task, and no hooks.post_integrate; setup_result.worktrees names exactly the lanes; repo.git_dir required in shadow mode; repo.branch must differ from repo.base_ref; lane_commands, notes, and backfill keys and done/reviewed entries must be known ids; lane ids prelude and join are reserved (ledger lanes); every task in done needs a backfill entry.

run_id.description: Part of branch names. Must not be a Windows device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-COM9, LPT1-LPT9) before its first '.'.

task_checks.description: Targeted checks a task runs before committing, keyed by task id (a batch unit uses its last task's entry). test is required and non-empty; lint and build, when absent, inherit the lane's commands. Never part of the delivery inventory: every command must be a narrower run of a check integration and verify already run, valid at the task that uses it, failing when it selects no tests.

widen_paths.description: Project-relative paths of shared infrastructure (a trailing / marks a directory). A task whose change touches one runs project-wide checks instead of its targeted ones.

repairs_spent.description: Repairs after a failing verify that earlier launches of this run made; the session carries it over on a relaunch or resume. A run allows 2 repairs in all (autonomous only).

id.description: Names ledger files and worktrees: must differ from every other lane id by more than letter case, and must not be a Windows device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-COM9, LPT1-LPT9) before its first '.'. Must not be a JavaScript property name (__proto__, constructor, hasOwnProperty, isPrototypeOf, propertyIsEnumerable, toLocaleString, toString, valueOf, __defineGetter__, __defineSetter__, __lookupGetter__, __lookupSetter__).

hooks.description: Optional; a manifest without it runs as if it were {}.

autonomy.description: Default autonomous: blocked tasks, questions, review caps and pre-flight conflicts go to the adjudicator; supervised stops and waits as Plan 1 did.

profile.description: Default full. lite: one lane worked on the feature branch, no integrate agent, one combined final reviewer; not allowed with hooks.post_integrate.

setup_result.description: scripts/setup output; required when dry_run is false (there is no setup agent).

additionalProperties.description: Absolute: /... or a Windows drive path (C:/... or C:\...).

setup_skipped.description: Lane ids whose setup commands setup skipped because every task of the lane is in done and reviewed. A lane with no setup commands is never listed. validateManifest rejects a listed lane that has pending work.

index_commit.description: The staged version (git write-tree on the worktree's index), committed on the worktree's HEAD; commit's parent. Null when nothing was staged or write-tree failed.

index_saved.description: False when write-tree on the index failed (an unmerged index, a held index.lock): the staged version is not saved, and the working-copy snapshot still is.

index_error.description: git's message when index_saved is false.

preserved.description: Commits under refs/parallel-lanes/<run_id>/abandoned/ holding changes setup discarded: commit holds the working copy (every tracked change and untracked, non-ignored file) on top of index_commit, or on the worktree's HEAD when index_commit is null. When write-tree on the index fails (an unmerged index, a held index.lock), index_saved is false and setup goes on with the working-copy snapshot; a held index.lock then also fails the following reset --hard, so setup exits 1 and the changes stay both in the worktree and in the saved ref. Restore in the worktree with git checkout <commit> -- . (the files), then git read-tree <index_commit> (what was staged; git read-tree HEAD when index_commit is null). Intent-to-add entries come back untracked. index_commit, index_saved and index_error are absent in results of setup before 1.6.2.

start_points.description: Feature heads from the ledger run_started events (ledger status start_points).

join_started.description: 1.6.5: ledger status join_started, a join task started in an earlier launch (the join then runs serially). Required once start_points.join is set.

unit_branches.description: 1.6.5: ledger status unit_branches, the join units that ran on their own branch pl-<run_id>-u-<unit> in a lane worktree.

wave_merges.description: 1.6.5: ledger status wave_merges, the wave_merged events of earlier launches ({wave or recovery, units, head, overlaps, conflict_files}).

join_tip.description: 1.6.5: ledger backfill join_tip, the join's last commit; integration's history audit allows final-fix commits after it.

start_bases.description: 1.6.5: ledger status start_bases, the base each task not done started its latest attempt from; a join task resumed on the feature checkout after waves starts there.

notes.description: Resume only: the user's answer to a blocked task's question, per task id; passed to that task's agents.

backfill.description: Commits of every task in done (from ledger committed events). A done but unreviewed task is reviewed before its lane continues; each head is the next task's review base.

overlaps.description: Files tasks in different lanes both change on purpose; the only way a file may appear in two lanes.

validation.description: Optional: how the merged file is checked (a command, or what to look at); the integration agent runs it.

excluded.description: Plan tasks the run leaves out, each with why (scripts/coverage checks the plan against the manifest).

allow_deferral.description: Default true: the adjudicator may park or unblock a non-security task (the run is then not accepted). false: every park or unblock is a stop.

deferred.description: Resume: ledger status deferred (parked or unblocked tasks); each must be in done.

python.description: Optional, default python3: the Python every command the skill and its agents run starts with, shell-quoted (scripts/find-python prints it; an absolute path, in C:/... form on Windows). The skill always sets it when it builds or resumes a manifest.

id.description: Exactly as in the plan heading; a safe file name (it names brief, report and review files). Must differ from every other task id by more than letter case, and must not be a Windows device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-COM9, LPT1-LPT9) before its first '.'. Must not be a JavaScript property name (__proto__, constructor, hasOwnProperty, isPrototypeOf, propertyIsEnumerable, toLocaleString, toString, valueOf, __defineGetter__, __defineSetter__, __lookupGetter__, __lookupSetter__).

files.description: Project-relative paths with / separators; none may be absolute (/... or C:/...), contain a backslash or a ':' (D:foo names another drive, a.js:s an NTFS stream), or leave the project. Compared normalized and case-insensitively across lanes.

depends_on.description: code: needs the producer's real code (prelude, earlier in the same lane, or the dependent in join); contract: builds against the plan's contract. No cycles.
